newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek FAGE's $120mln bond well placed - Citibank.
newsitem.headline: Greek FAGE's $120mln bond well placed - Citibank.

text.p: FAGE's $120 million corporate bond was well placed in the US market, Citibank-Athens said in a statement.
"Rising competition in the dairy foods sector and the company's favourable growth prospects required a capital injection," Citibank said.
The balloon bond with a fixed rate of 9.0 percent matures in 10 years. It is a high-yielder which was absorbed by US institutional investors, it said.
"It was the first issue of a high yield corporate bond by a Greek company in the US and it was a successful private debt placement," Citibank said.

Citibank advised FAGE on the prospectus which had to be filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission and promoted the bond to institutional investors. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
